tspan.tspan: Every movement begins as an electrical signal. This demo lets you
control a game using the signals measured from your muscles.
EMG is widely used in biomechanics, rehabilitation, sports science,
prosthetics, and human-computer interaction: It provides insight into

text.tspan: how the nervous system controls movement.

tspan.tspan: Electrodes placed on the skin detect your muscle activation in real
time. The EMG signal is then converted into a control input for the

text.tspan: game: The stronger you contract, the higher the bird will fly!

tspan.tspan: Electromyography (EMG) is a technique used to measure the

text.tspan: electrical activity produced by skeletal muscles.

tspan.tspan: When your brain sends a signal to contract a muscle, motor
neurons activate groups of muscle fibres. This activation
generates tiny electrical signals known as muscle action
Surface EMG records these signals using electrodes placed on
The strength of the EMG signal generally increases as more

text.tspan: motor units are recruited and muscles produce greater force.
